NonlinearHistoryAcceptance.description:
Acceptance of the members over the records (``fem.acceptance``). Method
``fibreStrain``: each fibre's peak strain at the member's end sections against a share of
the strain at which its material fails.

deformationShare.description: A member's deformation may reach at most this × the deformation at which it fails.
deformationShare.title: Deformationshare

residualStrengthShare.description: Strength (share of the peak) below which the component has failed.
residualStrengthShare.title: Residualstrengthshare

gravityLossAllMembers.description: The smaller of the gravity-loss and the strength-loss deformation for every member (false: the gravity loss only for members carrying gravity loads).
gravityLossAllMembers.title: Gravitylossallmembers

reinforcementFractureStrain.description: Strain at which a reinforcing bar is taken as lost (fracture or buckling).
reinforcementFractureStrain.title: Reinforcementfracturestrain

steelFractureStrain.description: Strain at which a structural steel fibre is taken as lost.
steelFractureStrain.title: Steelfracturestrain

note.description: Why the values are what they are.
note.title: Note

NonlinearHistoryDrift.description:
The storey drift of the nonlinear time histories against the allowable drift of the
linear procedures (the pack's ``seismic`` drift table, with its redundancy rule).

limitFactor.description: The drift may reach this × the allowable storey drift of the linear procedures.
limitFactor.title: Limitfactor

amplify.description: Whether the drifts are multiplied by Cd/I (false: the nonlinear drifts are the real ones).
amplify.title: Amplify

note.description: Why the values are what they are.
note.title: Note

NonlinearHistoryDrift.title: NonlinearHistoryDrift

NonlinearHistoryProcedure.description: How the nonlinear time histories are run and read (``fem.nonlinear_history``).

target.description: The ``seismic.timeHistory.targets`` entry the records are scaled to (its R and I; the period range, ratios and least number of records of that table apply).
target.title: Target

meanFrom.description: From this many records (or pairs) the design value is the mean of their peak responses, with fewer the largest.
meanFrom.title: Meanfrom

scaleToStaticShear.description: Whether the responses are scaled up to the equivalent static base shear (the nonlinear results are used as they come when false).
scaleToStaticShear.title: Scaletostaticshear

pDelta.description: P-Delta effects in the columns and walls.
pDelta.title: Pdelta

designReview.description: The code asks for an independent design review.
designReview.title: Designreview
